Subject: Pricing inquiry — Hosted API volume commitment and compliance gating

Hi Dev —

Thanks again for the product demo last week. HelioHealth is excited about the latency profile and token cost math on Redwood's hosted API. We are evaluating a 12-month usage commitment and want to understand the pricing tiers for per-token discounts.

Two important constraints from our side:
- Our legal team requires an executed DPA and access to SOC 2 Type II evidence (redacted is fine) before approving any committed discount.
- Procurement would like an outline of the billing cadence and whether credits or upfront commit are options versus pure per-token billing.

Can you send a proposed tiered pricing schedule, any options for upfront credits, and the compliance gating checklist your contracts team requires?

Goal: get commercial terms to procurement by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Elena Santos
Senior Procurement Manager
HelioHealth
elena.santos@heliohealth.com

From: dev_patel@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing inquiry — Hosted API volume commitment and compliance gating

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the clear asks and timeline. Short answer: we can offer tiered per-token discounts tied to committed monthly volumes, and we can also structure partial upfront credits for a blended effective rate. There are two compliance conditions that gate the deeper committed discounts: an executed DPA and access to SOC 2 Type II evidence. We can accept redacted SOC2 artifacts and host them on a secure link for your legal team review.

High-level pricing options (illustrative):
- Flex (no commit): $0.0008/token (pay-as-you-go)
- Commit-1 (6-12k USD/month commit): $0.0006/token (5% discount to Flex)
- Commit-2 (50k USD/month commit): $0.00045/token (20% discount)
- Commit-3 (250k USD/month commit + 12mo): $0.00030/token (45% discount)

Upfront credit option: we can accept a pre-paid credit (applied monthly) to guarantee capacity and smooth billing; this is often paired with Commit-2/3 and yields a further 3–5% effective uplift depending on term.

Compliance gating: for Commit-2+ pricing we require:
1) Signed DPA (we can push a DPA template and accept redlines)
2) SOC 2 Type II evidence (redacted PDF or secure view)
3) Customer point of contact for compliance questions (name + email)

I'll attach a one-pager that maps commit tiers to required approvals and a draft DPA with common redlines flagged. If you can share your legal contact, we can start parallel review so it doesn't delay pricing.

Proposed next steps:
- I’ll upload redacted SOC2 to a secure link this afternoon.
- Marissa (cc'd) will weigh-in on discount flexibility for a first-year promotional credit.
- If acceptable, we can prepare a Term Sheet + DocuSign ready quote by Thursday.

Best,
Dev Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Hi Elena / Dev —

Thanks for the context. Quick internal note for transparency: I can approve up to 30% discount at close for new mid-market accounts, but anything deeper (Commit-3 / 45% listed) needs legal/finance signoff and confirmation that SOC2 + DPA are in place. If HelioHealth can commit to a 12-month minimum and provide the SOC2 link by Wednesday, I'm willing to offer a one-time onboarding credit equal to one month's commit (applied as pre-pay) to soften first-month consumption variance.

Dev — please outline the exact evidence format (redacted sections ok) and the DPA turnaround expectation so procurement can plan.
